name: truck-loader
title: Truck Loader
description: A flat side-view delivery truck idles on a thin road line, dipping on its suspension while dashed markings and lamp posts slide behind it. It loops forever as a loading indicator.
use: A delivery, shipping or checkout screen needs a friendly loading graphic that says the order is on its way.
avoid: Light themes, since the truck's dark outlines and fixed red and grey fills need source edits to restyle.
a11y: Has a status role and a Loading label, but the endless loop ignores reduced-motion preferences. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A pale grey box trailer with a red cab, dark wheels and a small yellow headlight sits on a thin horizontal road line. Grey lamp posts slide across a near-black stage behind it.
behaves: The truck body dips and rises on its suspension while the road dashes and lamp posts travel right to left on a loop. Motion runs continuously and never settles.
customise: Only className is exposed. Truck colours, the 200x100 box, speeds and the road colour variable must be changed in the source CSS.
weight: light: A handful of SVG shapes moved by three short CSS keyframe loops.
demo: Out for delivery heading, with order #48213 and a 2:00 to 4:00 pm delivery window
issues: A lamp post passes in front of the truck in frame 4, breaking the depth illusion.
polishWhy: Tidy flat illustration with smooth looping motion; the lamp overlap is a small flaw.
